annotations.title: Share a collection with another workspace

description: Map a collection into another space you belong to (e.g. a shared client space), or remove that mapping. Requires membership of both spaces. space_id is the TARGET space (id or name from list_spaces); do not put it in `space`, which is the space you act from. Pass remove=true to unmap it from space_id instead (visibility from that space ends immediately; the origin space cannot be removed).

collectionId.description: collection_id is the collection to map into the target space.

remove.description:
remove unmaps the collection from space_id instead of mapping it in. It
 cannot remove the collection's origin space (the domain enforces this).

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

spaceId.description:
space_id is the TARGET space to map the collection into - an id or a name
 from list_spaces. (Do NOT confuse it with `space` below, which is the
 space you are acting FROM.)

name: share_collection
